APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_II.title: AICTE Web-Portal Payment Receipt (if any)
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_II.summary: Copy of pay receipt print made on AICTE Web-Portal if any, in respect of Extension of Approval for the respective Academic Year.
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_II.excerpt: Copy of pay receipt print made on AICTE Web-Portal if any, in respect of Extension of Approval for the respective Academic Year.

APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_III.title: Building Occupancy / Completion Certificate
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_III.summary: Valid Occupancy/ Completion Certificate/ Building License/ Form D issued by the Competent Authority as cross-referred to Clause 7.17 (drafting cross-reference to Chapter VI Clause 6.17(g)).
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_III.cross_reference_notes: Annexure-2 §2.1(iii) literally cites 'Clause 7.17 of the Approval Process Handbook', which is a drafting cross-reference to Chapter VI Clause 6.17(g).
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_III.excerpt: As per Clause 7.17 of the Approval Process Handbook, valid Occupancy/ Completion Certificate/ Building License/ Form D issued by the Competent Authority.

APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_IV.title: Structural Stability Certificate (> 30 Years)
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_IV.summary: Valid Structural Stability Certificate from registered Structural Engineer if Building is more than thirty years from the issue of Completion Certificate.
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_IV.excerpt: Valid Structural Stability Certificate from the registered Structural Engineer, if the Building is more than thirty years from the issue of Completion Certificate that the Building is fit for human habitation.

APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_V.title: Valid Fire Safety Certificate
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_V.summary: A valid Fire Safety Certificate issued by the Competent Authority.
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_V.excerpt: A valid Fire Safety Certificate issued by the Competent Authority.

APH_2024_27_CHAP_2_TABLE_2_1.title: TER Fee Schedule for Extension of Approval (EoA)
APH_2024_27_CHAP_2_TABLE_2_1.summary: Statutory Technical Education Regulatory (TER) Charges schedule payable online to AICTE based on institution category.

APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_G.title: Occupancy Certificate Norms & Government Building Act Exemption
APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_G.summary: Occupancy Certificate/ Completion Certificate/ Building License/ Form D (as applicable) shall be obtained from Competent Authority. For Government Buildings, the Government Building Act, 1899 is applicable.
APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_G.cross_reference_notes: Annexure-2 §2.1(iii) cross-refers to this clause as 'Clause 7.17'.
APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_G.excerpt: Occupancy Certificate/ Completion Certificate/ Building License/ Form D (as applicable) shall be obtained from the Competent Authority (as per standard format prescribed by the issuing Authority). For Government Buildings, the Government Building Act, 1899 is applicable.

APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_H.title: Structural Stability Certificate 30-Year Rule & 5-Year Validity
APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_H.summary: After expiry of thirty years from issue of Completion Certificate, Structural Stability Certificate from registered Structural Engineer certifying human habitation safety is mandatory. Structural Stability Certificate is valid for a period of FIVE years from date of issue.
APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_H.excerpt: After the expiry of a period of thirty years from the issue of Completion Certificate, a Structural Stability Certificate from the registered Structural Engineer for the purpose of certifying that the Building is safe for human habitation shall be produced. Structural Stability Certificate is valid for a period of FIVE years from the date of issue.

APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_I.title: Mandatory Fire Safety Certificate
APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_I.summary: A valid Fire Safety Certificate shall be obtained from the Competent Authority.
APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_I.excerpt: A valid Fire Safety Certificate shall be obtained from the Competent Authority.

APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_J.title: State-Wise Competent Authorities Reference
APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_J.summary: State wise Competent Authorities for issuing the Certificates pertaining to the Land/ Building including Occupancy Certificate as given in Annexure-14 of the Approval Process Handbook.
APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_J.excerpt: State wise Competent Authorities for issuing the Certificates pertaining to the Land/ Building including Occupancy Certificate as given in Annexure-14 of the Approval Process Handbook.

APH_2024_27_ANNEX_3_CLAUSE_3_1_D.summary: Fire and life Safety Certificate from Fire Department of the concerned State Government authority is to be taken before submitting the application at AICTE.
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_3_CLAUSE_3_1_D.excerpt: Fire and life Safety Certificate from Fire Department of the concerned State Government authority is to be taken before submitting the application at AICTE.
